snippet.title: Magic Mess: Restore Order to the Wizard's Tower! Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Magic Mess: Restore Order to the Wizard's Tower! is a cozy single-player organization simulator. Return 3,040 scattered items, including books, potions, scrolls, and crystals, to their proper places and restore order to the wizard's tower. Don't let your dragon waiting outside distract you.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5012990/Magic_Mess_Restore_Order_to_the_Wizards_Tower/
